prompt:
Project rule:
In a React handler that mutates then refetches, `await` the refetch completely before the
`finally` block flips the loading/disabled state back off. A fire-and-forget
`fetch(...).then(...)` lets the button re-enable and the UI claim it is done before the
displayed data has refreshed, so the user can double-click into a stale state.
Write the refetch as `await fetch(...)`, then await reading its json, then set state.

Write typescript code that follows this rule. Output only code.
